description: Mixes eight inputs into four outputs by geometry: the inputs stand on a circle and the outputs at the corners of a square, and each input reaches each output in proportion to how close the two are

params.text: Turns the whole ring of inputs around the centre, -360 to +360 degrees
Sets how far the inputs stand from the centre, 0 for all eight piled at the middle and 100 for the full circle
Sets how far the four output corners stand from the centre, 0 for all four at the middle and 100 for the full square

inputs.text: One of the eight inputs, fixed at its own point on the ring; it arrives at each output in proportion to its closeness to that output's corner
Turns the ring further, 18 degrees per volt, added to the ANGLE knob
Moves the inputs in or out, 10 units per volt on the same 0 to 100 scale as the knob, added to the RADIUS IN knob and never allowed below 0
Moves the output corners in or out, 10 units per volt on the same 0 to 100 scale as the knob, added to the RADIUS OUT knob and never allowed below 0

outputs.text: One of four outputs, each standing at its own corner of the square; every input arrives here scaled by 128 minus its distance from this corner, over 128, so a distance beyond 128 inverts it

notes: The three CV jacks are read once per input channel, so a polyphonic cable into any of them moves each channel's ring independently.
The outputs take as many channels as the widest of the connected inputs, and an input with fewer channels contributes nothing to the ones it does not have.
With nothing patched into any of the eight inputs the outputs are set to no channels at all.
